tweet.text:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is pressing President Trump to launch renewed strikes against Iran.

It comes a week after the WSJ reported the US had warned Gulf Arab states to prepare for a possible short, intense military campaign against Iran after tomorrow’s midterm elections.
